name: Ulti Ho Gayi Sab Tadbeerein
abstract:
All remedies went in vain, no medicine worked
See how this ailment of the heart finally finished me...

content.original:
الٹی ہو گئیں سب تدبیریں کچھ نہ دوا نے کام کیا
دیکھا اس بیماری دل نے آخر کام تمام کیا
content.transliteration:
Ulti ho gayin sab tadbeerein kuch na dawa ne kaam kiya
Dekha is beemaari-e-dil ne aakhir kaam tamaam kiya
content.translation:
All remedies went in vain, no medicine worked
See how this ailment of the heart finally finished me
